budget_items.topic: FY15 COA budget share of town budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director said the COA budget is only .4% of the overall budget, with seniors about 25% of the population.
budget_items.quote: is only .4% of the overall budget, with seniors comprising of about 25% of the population.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY15 budget includes a 3% contractual increase in the Director's salary.
budget_items.quote: including a 3% contractual increase in the director's salary

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY15 budget includes an approximately 60 cent an hour increase for the Administrative Assistants, depending on union negotiations.
budget_items.quote: approximately 60 cents an hour increase in the administrative assistants salary

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two new dietary aides hired part time were to be paid from the Formula Grant.
budget_items.quote: their salaries will be paid out of the formula grant.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Senior Center's supplementation of Soup & Salad days makes it necessary to increase the dollar amount in the FY15 budget for the kitchen program.
budget_items.quote: increase the dollar amount to the fy15 budget for the kitchen program

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The training line increase is for retraining staff when changes occur.
budget_items.quote: is for retraining staff members when changes occur.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion concerned taxation on seniors' earnings in the Tax Work-Off Program; the Town Accountant said it follows IRS regulations.
budget_items.quote: discussion ensued concerning the taxation on the earnings of the seniors in this program.
